scope: manual integer-translation experiment; not enabled or linked into the application

method.comparison: full field baseline; fixed common crop; equal-size translated common crop
method.injection: one frame, FWHM 5 px, original coordinate plus measured shift; shifts computed on uninjected originals
method.recovery: new trigger during injection whose selected peak sample actually brightened
method.timing: translation includes native conversion/bin/search; pipeline includes injection/copy/EventCapture; excludes reading, initial template, GUI, evidence output
method.preview: labelled derived TEST crops only; never evidence

limitations: short prefixes, one selected injection position/time per scene, no probability estimate
candidate counts hide persistent firing; inspect passingFrames/firingFrames/longestFiringRunFrames
no ground-truth archive shifts, subpixel test, Bayer phase handling, local deformation, template renewal, or injected-flash influence on shift estimate
rim and RGB recoveries are saturation-limited; no unclipped sensitivity gain established
no suitable earthshine sequence identified; field acceptance remains open
source-time capture holds and motion-following injection centres differ from older Feature-9 measurements
timing uses precomputed shifts and cached frames, not end-to-end camera throughput
decision: keep registration experimental; investigate startup/reference holding/rearming and repeat longer common-crop controls with multiple independent injections and unclipped data
localArtifacts: out/qa-registration (ignored; full traces, configs, labelled PNGs and logs)
